name: Stealth Internet
summary: Stealth Internet, formed 1997 in Brisbane as the internet arm of RMI Telecommunications; dialup ISP + web hosting; expanded to Griffith NSW 1998; ISP business sold 2002 (stealth.com.au passed into the WebFront/iiNet orbit, hosted on iiNet today); brand retired 2003; web-hosting lineage continued (Ultrawave 2003, Omosis 2005); brand relaunched 2019; acquired by Obble Pty Ltd 2021 (OBBLE PTY LTD (acquired Stealth Internet brand 2021 - current operator of stealth.net.au), ACN 648 809 750).

events.details: Stealth Internet formed 1997 as the internet arm of RMI Telecommunications; commenced operations as an ISP in Brisbane (dialup + web hosting).
Expanded to regional NSW with a regional ISP in Griffith NSW; parent RMI Telecommunications Pty Ltd took over operations of Stealth Internet.

Internet service provider business of Stealth Internet sold (2002); web-hosting division remained. By Dec 2002 stealth.com.au carried the 'WebFront joins the iiNet Group!' banner (linking iinet.net.au/news/webfront.html); stealth.com.au is hosted on iiNet today (NS ns1-3.iinet.net.au; IP 203.0.178.91 in APNIC IINET-TECH-AU).

events.details: Stealth Internet brand retired; parent RMI Telecommunications launched broadband ISP Ultrawave Internet (ADSL/ISDN + webhosting), which DART Internet acquired Sep 2003.
Webhosting provider Omosis Digital formed (parent lineage).
Stealth Internet brand relaunched as a webhosting provider by original management under the original parent company.
Stealth Internet acquired by Obble Pty Ltd; continues to operate as Stealth Internet.
